name: Shadowswyft
traits: Medium Outsider from the Plane of Shadow. The species entry gives the Extraplanar subtype away from that plane. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person cannot target a Shadowswyft.
+2 Dexterity, −2 Constitution. Land speed 40 ft. Darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision.
Light Blindness is extraordinary. Abrupt exposure to bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds the Shadowswyft for 1 round. Afterward, it remains dazzled while in the affected area.
Dazzled imposes −1 on attack rolls, Search checks, and Spot checks. Use the normal Blinded condition for the first round.
+2 bonus on initiative checks. +4 racial bonuses on Hide and Move Silently.
Automatic languages are Shadowswyft and Common. Bonus languages are Abyssal, Celestial, and Elven. Favored class Rogue. LA +1. The player profile adds no racial Hit Dice.
